authority: Documentation comparison and at most two read-only source checks; no full economic study, stock returns, new experiment or old-source reopening.

documentation_comparison.F19: Prefer direct guaranty-assessment liability, recoverable offset and actual utilization fields; investigate whether group materiality and a distinctive forecast survive accounting/industry substitutes.
documentation_comparison.F09: Investigate an actual supplier agreement/status rather than treating a general critical-vendor order as payment entitlement. Separate protected prepetition debt from new shipments and later loss.
documentation_comparison.F07: Third lead: inspection/detention must join a dated vessel-specific hire allocation, not a generic off-hire clause. Public legal precedent is documentation context, not a third detention sample.
documentation_comparison.F18: Rolling scope lists and confidential sanction reasons do not identify transferred test volumes, customer requirements or financially material demand. No source case acquisition selected.
documentation_comparison.F14: Quota/bycatch observations do not identify listed producers' replacement inventory or procurement commitments. No source case acquisition selected.

source_limits.browser_accounting: Documentation discovery is separate; underlying fetch counts and costs unknown. It is not a way to retrieve a denied original. Thirty-two search queries preceded this plan and exposed snippets, including numerical values; cases are not an untouched evaluation sample.

F19.question: Are the timing and usability of offsets actually recorded, and can they support an assessment-net-burden question at financially material listed exposure?
F19.case_frame: Penn Treaty/ANIC 2017 insolvency as mechanism context; Voya Retirement Insurance and Annuity Company 2017/2018 annual statutory statements as a fixed two-year field/identifier audit; Aetna 2017 first-half original filing as a separately labelled group-materiality check. Voya fields cannot be assigned to Aetna. Selection is diagnostic and availability-based after documentation search, not a representative insurer sample or an economic comparison.
expected_fields: insolvency-specific duration and discounting where reported
F19.fallback_policy: Explicit issuer/regulator links and exact historical parent filings within the fixed dates may resolve the same fields; no paid statutory database or state tax return request. Do not infer realized capacity from a state law or book asset alone.

F09.question: Can original public documents identify enforceable/conditional payment protection, its amount and materially exposed supplier, with contemporaneous timing?
F09.case_frame: Toys R Us September 2017 Chapter 11 and March 2018 liquidation; fixed listed toy suppliers Mattel and Hasbro. This is one shared distress episode, not two independent shocks. Mattel's later SEC response was located during documentation search and is not a neutral unseen validation outcome. Hasbro remains even if no agreement is located.
expected_fields: first observed public filing date distinct from contract date
F09.fallback_policy: Exact SEC issuer filings, SEC correspondence and legitimate public original docket links for the fixed supplier/episode may be reserved before dispatch. No paid PACER, credentials, claims corpus, expired signed URLs, confidential attachments or names-as-protection proxy. Permission to pay is never coded as payment received.

evidence_rules: For each link use VERIFIED, PLAUSIBLE, MISSING, INACCESSIBLE or NOT REQUIRED. A verified disclosure is not independent verification of the author's causal attribution.
A missing historical public clock limits Level B, not automatically a valid disclosed Level A study. An unobserved economic variable cannot be repaired by a timing disclaimer.
No test statistic, forecast scoring, returns, correlation, signal selection from later outcomes or full sample acquisition. Simple reconciliation of source rows is source verification.
Acquire only sufficient originals to decide observability, materiality and differentiation; do not use every remaining start automatically.
Keep originals under ignored data/raw/discovery_bottleneck_20261021/. Reuse existing private collector/projection helpers with new isolated state and no dependency changes.
